messages:
Maya (People Ops): heads-up: lockdown for midcycle forms is 03/31 23:59 PT for NA, extended 04/02 23:59 CET for EMEA. posting the official calendar now.
Dev (Eng Lead): quick Q : one of my managers will be on PTO on the 31st. can they delegate their calibration slot to a peer?
Maya (People Ops): yes : managers may delegate. the delegate must be listed on the public slot doc and confirm on the invite. also update the "owner" field in the tracker.
Hannah (Manager): can a delegate approve late-evidence exceptions on behalf of the original manager, or does it require the primary manager's approval code?
Maya (People Ops): delegates can approve but they must enter the same approval code flow. we record the approver name on the exception. if the original manager is required by policy, People Ops will flag during QA.
Ishaan (SWE): upload note: attachments over 10MB fail intermittently. what's the manual intake procedure?
forms-bot: Forms v2 note: max upload 50MB but large uploads may timeout. Fallback: email people-ops@redwood with subject "REVIEW-EVIDENCE + <employee>". Include manager note and what the file is.
Dev (Eng Lead): can we get an "on-call safe" marker on the schedule? some calibrations fall during pager windows.
Maya (People Ops): yes : adding an "on-call safe" boolean to the public doc. if a slot is not safe, mark it and we'll reserve a fallback slot next day.
Hannah (Manager): timebox reminder: what should calibrators assume per case? last cycle we overran.
Maya (People Ops): please use 3-5 minutes per case. we'll add this to invites and the quick checklist.
Ishaan (SWE): about late exceptions : what's the minimum info needed for the manager note?
Maya (People Ops): manager note should state reason, date evidence was gathered, and whether the employee had notice. include approver name and approval code. concise is fine.
Dev (Eng Lead): will there be a recorded rubric walkthrough for new managers?
Maya (People Ops): yes : Wed 10:00 walkthrough will be recorded. slides and a 1-page cheat sheet will be uploaded to the tracker.
ops-bot: Banner posted in #general: "Calibration window Apr 3-4; expect delayed responses from reviewer threads."
Maya (People Ops): last ops checklist: 1) publish read-only calendar 2) add on-call safe column 3) announce mute windows for hiring digests 4) enable delegate flow in tracker 5) confirm fallback intake email. ping me if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
